programmes.d: A bounty hunter, armed with a hatchet instead of a gun, is hired by a crippled mayor to recover a kidnapped woman. Along the way he uncovers a plot to loot silver mines and settles an old score.
Two con artists (James Mason, Gina Lollobrigida) bring an outlaw (Lee Van Cleef) into their scheme to bilk the Mexican government out of $1 million.
Mexican bandit brothers (Gian Maria Volonte, Klaus Kinski) lure a U.S. mercenary (Lou Castel) to join their revolution, complicated by an assassination plot.
The efforts of a crooked rancher to monopolize water rights are stymied by a young widow and a hired killer.
An arms dealer needs to rob a bank in order to make a delivery.
A gunslinger, a vengeful ex-slave and a runaway discover their train is haunted by a sinister force.
In one of the first horror films in Welsh, a farmer unearths an ancient stone head that triggers the murderous wrath of sacred Celtic gods.
A white European orphan (Enrique Saldana) believes himself to be an African tribe's predestined ruler.
After his wife's death, professional bodyguard Long Wei goes overseas to find doctors for his daughter, but instead he finds a new job as a virtual reality tester.
A young woman (Susan Bracken) visiting her grandmother realizes there is a killer in the house.
A shaman turns a newlywed woman into a vampiric white reindeer after she seeks his help.
A group of rural villagers is beset upon by the infamous vampire Sava Savanovic, who has taken up residence in the local flour mill.
The chairman (Richard Boone) of a cemetery thinks a person dies when he moves their pin on a plot chart.
Five men and two women, marooned survivors of an air crash, discover that they may be the only survivors of a world disaster.
The story of a slaughterhouse worker (Damien Leake) and union trouble culminates in the Chicago race riot of 1919.
